title: A Crown for the Spire Anew
author: Oscar Voss
blurb: Quentin Ashgrove, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
